sections.title: Stage 10 · Legend: beyond prodigy
sections.html:
Stage 10 · Legend: beyond prodigy

Five targets with no finish line. Fifteen 3-digit numbers flashed at 0.4, 0.3 and 0.2 seconds, 3-digit times 3-digit in the head, and fifteen-line head sums.

Where this stage goes

The level goal. Fifteen 3-digit numbers flashed at 0.3 seconds or faster, and 3 × 3 multiplication in the head. Competition level.

In plain words. Fifteen numbers flashed at 0.3 seconds. Three-digit times three-digit in the head. Competition speed. There is no top to this ladder.

How long. open-ended at fifteen minutes a day, six days a week.

There is no boss your child must beat to finish. Legend is a set of targets to chase for as long as it is fun. Each one cleared goes on the chart.

The world record for fifteen 3-digit numbers is 1.61 seconds in total, about a tenth of a second a number. Nobody needs to get there. But the ladder has no top, and that is the fun of it.

Keep the routine the same as it has been since Sprout. Fifteen minutes. Same chair. Same time. A child at this level still gets better the same way a child at Stage 1 does.

The drills in this stage

  • Flash. Fifteen 3-digit numbers at 0.4, then 0.3, then 0.2 seconds. Trainer only for the true speed.
  • Mental. 3-digit times 3-digit, and fifteen 3-digit lines with plus and minus, both in the head.

Accuracy before speed

Pass marks sit at 75 percent here, and the long head sums at two in three. Even at this level the rule holds. Hold a speed until it is calm. A Legend who guesses at 0.2 seconds is not a Legend at 0.3.

Where this sits on the abacus ladders

Legend is competition level, past the end of every program in our map. On the flash anzan ladder, fifteen 3-digit numbers at 0.4 seconds is about 8th dan. At 0.3 seconds it is about 9th dan. At 0.2 seconds it is 10th dan, Bead Score rung 20, the top of the ladder. On the Times ladder, 3-digit times 3-digit is rung 10.

Parent lineFilm it. Then show the grandparents.

Lesson 10.1 · Flash: fifteen 3-digit at 0.4 s

Lesson 72 of 76. Stage 10, lesson 1 of 5. About 8 minutes. You need a grown-up to show or read the numbers. No soroban, no paper.

By the end, your child can add fifteen 3-digit numbers flashed at 0.4 seconds each.

The move

Fifteen numbers. Once the picture is steady, how many numbers there are matters less than how fast they come.

Hold 0.4 seconds until 8 of 10 rounds are right. Then move on.

A grown-up shows each number for 0.4 seconds on a card, or says it at that beat, once each. Your child says only the total. This speed is hard to hit by hand. sections.title: Lesson 10.4 · Mental: 3-digit × 3-digit
sections.html:
Lesson 10.4 · Mental: 3-digit × 3-digit

Lesson 75 of 76. Stage 10, lesson 4 of 5. About 15 minutes. You need no soroban. A pencil for the answers only.

By the end, your child can times a 3-digit number by a 3-digit number in the head.

The move

Nine small answers. Keep the rhythm, and keep the landing rods exact.

Each digit of the top number works through all three digits of the bottom number, one rod right each step. Then the next digit starts one rod further right than the last one did.

Worked example. 386 × 472 on the mental beads.

  • 3 × 4 = 12. It lands on the hundred thousands and ten thousands rods. Beads: .
  • 3 × 7 = 21. It lands on the ten thousands and thousands rods. Beads: .
  • 3 × 2 = 06. It lands on the thousands and hundreds rods. Beads: .
  • 8 × 4 = 32. It lands on the ten thousands and thousands rods. Beads: .
  • 8 × 7 = 56. It lands on the thousands and hundreds rods. Beads: .
  • 8 × 2 = 16. It lands on the hundreds and tens rods. Beads: .
  • 6 × 4 = 24. It lands on the thousands and hundreds rods. Beads: .
  • 6 × 7 = 42. It lands on the hundreds and tens rods. Beads: .
  • 6 × 2 = 12. It lands on the tens and ones rods. Beads: .
  • Read it: 182,192.
Parent lineGive this page as many quiet minutes as it needs, and do not talk until the answer comes.

Drill

No soroban. Work each small product on the mental beads, left to right. Write only the answer. Pass mark: 8 of 10 right. Not yet? Same page tomorrow.

Lesson 10.5 · Mental: fifteen 3-digit lines

Lesson 76 of 76. Stage 10, lesson 5 of 5. About 12 minutes. You need no soroban. A pencil for the answers only.

By the end, your child can add and take away fifteen 3-digit lines in the head.

The move

Fifteen lines, plus and minus. The exam marathon.

The pass mark is two in three. A long sum has many places to slip, and finishing calm is the real skill.

Parent lineRead the lines at one steady beat, and treat a finished sum as a win even when it is off.

sections.title: The Legend Boss
sections.html:
The Legend Boss

The Legend Boss is for the record, not a gate. Take it when the 0.3-second page is calm. Part 1 maps to Lesson 10.2. Part 2 maps to 10.4. Film it.

The printed test is Boss 10 in boss-tests.md. It has 2 parts:

  • Flash fifteen 3-digit at 0.3 s. 5 rounds. Need 4 of 5 in 4 minutes.
  • Mental 3 × 3. 4 problems. Need 3 of 4 in 6 minutes.

sections.title: What the trainer adds to this stage
sections.html:
What the trainer adds to this stage

At Legend, the trainer is the only way to see the true speeds. A tenth of a second is a blink. It also keeps every Bead Score your child has ever taken on one chart, from the first rung in Stage 5 to here.

The paper pages stay useful for the head sums and the times problems, and as listening drills on long drives.
